sentences.text: Constellate computed a modest symptom similarity between mucopolysaccharidosis type 7 and mucopolysaccharidosis type 3, with a score of 0.273 over 25 shared terms [e_251c174295f2].
The top shared term is heparan sulfate in urine [e_251c174295f2].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_251c174295f2].

The causes differ: type 7 is curated as caused by GUSB, while type 3 is linked to GNS and HGSNAT only by inferred roll-ups from subtypes at confidence 0.475, which may not hold for every form [e_c93bcd95cdca] [e_31e8d8274b07] [e_ed375158e5b0].
Type 3 has two studies on ClinicalTrials.gov, a gene therapy study not yet recruiting and a cannabidiol study that is recruiting [e_293f8f633c73] [e_1246a2f623f5].
The Cure Sanfilippo Foundation is linked to type 3 only by an automatic name match [e_a1a9b68fc263].
For type 7, two observed features are listed, reduced beta-glucuronidase activity and spatulate ribs, each from a single report [e_cdbce88e10b5] [e_42b9049bb025].
These edges do not show that the type 3 studies apply to type 7, and they do not show that any drug works [e_251c174295f2] [e_293f8f633c73] [e_1246a2f623f5].
